name: Account hacked or compromised
description: Customers report unauthorized access to their accounts, deleted playlists, and repeated security breaches.

name: Account recovery and password reset issues
description: Customers struggle to recover accounts, reset passwords, and lack security features like two-factor authentication.

name: Unexpected logout and session loss
description: Customers are frequently logged out without action, losing playlists and account data.

name: Login authentication failures
description: Customers cannot log in with correct credentials, phone numbers, or social media accounts.

name: Account signup and registration failures
description: Customers cannot create new accounts or complete signup process.

name: Premium paywall on basic features
description: Customers report essential features like shuffle control and song seeking locked behind premium subscription.

name: Premium subscription too expensive
description: Customers find the subscription cost too high and unaffordable.

name: Refund requests not processed
description: Customers report difficulty obtaining refunds for cancelled subscriptions or charged amounts.

name: Premium subscription not activating
description: Customers pay for premium but features remain locked or unavailable after purchase.

name: Unexpected or duplicate charges
description: Customers report being charged twice, unable to update payment methods, or continued charges after cancellation.

name: Lyrics feature missing or unavailable
description: Customers cannot view song lyrics despite having premium or waiting for feature availability.

name: Limited music catalog and missing songs
description: Customers report favorite songs unavailable and limited music selection on the platform.

name: Podcast features buggy and incomplete
description: Customers report podcast bugs, missing parental controls, and poor language filtering.

name: Unwanted songs added to playlists
description: Customers report app automatically adding suggested songs to playlists they cannot remove.

name: Search functionality returns wrong results
description: Customers struggle to find songs and artists, receiving incorrect or irrelevant search results.

name: Songs fail to download
description: Customers cannot download playlists or individual songs for offline listening.

name: Downloaded songs disappear or unsave
description: Customers lose downloaded playlists and songs after updates or app restarts.

name: Offline mode requires daily redownload
description: Customers must redownload songs daily to listen offline, defeating offline functionality.

name: Downloads consume excessive device storage
description: Customers report downloads hogging internal storage and inability to move to external storage.

name: General app quality and performance poor
description: Customers express dissatisfaction with overall app functionality and quality.

name: Positive user experience
description: Customers praise the app when it works properly.

name: Unrelated complaints or unclear issues
description: Customers report issues unrelated to app functionality or provide unclear feedback.

name: Poor audio quality and low volume
description: Customers report low sound quality, weak bass, and unsupported audio formats.

name: Background playback stops or malfunctions
description: Customers report music stopping when switching apps or background playback not working.

name: Excessive battery and data consumption
description: Customers report severe battery drain and high data usage even during background playback.

name: Offline error despite active connection
description: Customers report app showing offline errors despite having WiFi or cellular connection.

name: App crashes or fails to open
description: Customers report frequent crashes, slow loading, and compatibility issues after updates.

name: Device connection and car mode issues
description: Customers cannot connect to car systems or other devices despite same account login.

name: App lag and buffering delays
description: Customers report slow interface performance, audio skipping, and buffering issues.

name: Playback stops unexpectedly
description: Customers report songs stopping mid-play or restarting without user action.

name: Customer support unresponsive
description: Customers report no response from support team despite multiple contact attempts.

name: Customer support provides no solutions
description: Customers report support gives generic responses and fails to resolve issues.

name: Excessive ads in free version
description: Customers report too many ads playing frequently, interrupting music listening.

name: Missing features and poor navigation
description: Customers report removed features like history, missing lyrics display, and confusing interface.

name: Playlist management and sharing broken
description: Customers cannot reorder songs, share playlists, or manage queue properly.

name: Forced shuffle and limited song selection
description: Customers cannot disable shuffle or choose specific songs without autoplay interference.

name: Recent UI redesign creates poor experience
description: Customers dislike new home screen layout and missing customization options.
